name: naive-reality-client
description: Native H3 by default: upstream Chromium networking with config rejection only. TCP REALITY is a separate opt-in profile.
wire_format: native-h3: standard TLS 1.3 and HTTP/3 CONNECT. tcp-reality: existing Xray TCP REALITY wire format.

patches.apply_with: git apply (or: patch -p1) from the boringssl root
patches.description: BoringSSL: new ssl/reality.cc + ssl/reality.h, public API SSL_set1_reality_config/SSL_clear_reality_config/SSL_reality_verify_certificate, ssl_st fields, ClientHello session-id patch hook, build registration.

patches.apply_with: git apply (or: patch -p1) from the src root
patches.description: net: RealityConfig global (net/socket/reality_config.{h,cc}), SSLClientSocketImpl wiring (SNI override + SSL_set1_reality_config + REALITY cert check + distinctive ERR_REALITY_REAL_TARGET), new net error -509, naive config.json/CLI parsing.

patches.apply_with: git apply (or: patch -p1) from the src root
patches.description: net/tools/naive: spider mode - on ERR_REALITY_REAL_TARGET, log and issue one ordinary-TLS GET to https://<server_name>/ via PreambleGetter, then fail.

patches.apply_with: git apply (or: patch -p1) from the src root
patches.description: Registers net/socket/reality_config.{cc,h} in src/net/BUILD.gn. IMPORTANT: naiveproxy's tree has NO net/socket/BUILD.gn - all net sources are listed flat in src/net/BUILD.gn.
Native H3 profile only: reject REALITY and custom QUIC configuration before opening sockets. Changes no network stack source.
Reject QUIC REALITY and retired QUIC tuning options in the optional TCP REALITY build.

build_notes: 001 edits build.json (authoritative source list) and the generated gen/sources.{gni,cmake,bzl,mk}. If the CI regenerates from build.json (go run ./util/pregenerate), the generated-file edits are redundant but harmless.

Chromium consumes boringssl via third_party/boringssl/BUILD.gn, which imports gen/sources.gni and references ssl_sources / ssl_internal_headers. That BUILD.gn is NOT in the naiveproxy git tree; no edit is needed there because the new files are added to the lists it already imports.

002/003 add net/socket/reality_config.{h,cc}; 004 registers them in src/net/BUILD.gn (verified: upstream naiveproxy has no net/socket/BUILD.gn; socket sources are listed flat in net/BUILD.gn around line 1015).
Native H3 applies only 005; TCP REALITY applies 001-004 and 006. Never combine 005 with the TCP REALITY patches. Retired 010/011/012 are available only in git history.

native-h3.description: Standard TLS with an operator-owned certificate. No REALITY, QUIC tuning, BoringSSL, or QUICHE patches.

tcp-reality.description: Optional TCP REALITY only. QUIC+REALITY configuration is rejected.
